scope_note: Proposed records only. None of these is accepted scope until the user approves; none deletes or renumbers any XRAI-* or XRAI31-* id. Statuses use the BOOT-00 vocabulary SPECIFIED | SOURCE_UNVERIFIED | RIGHTS_BLOCKED; nothing here is CODED or TESTED.

records.title: Daily rhythm loop: energy check-in, one action or rest, evening reflection, weekly review (Bugün)
found_in: constitution v2.1 §31.2 LF-04 Adaptive Life Rhythm (line 26955)
records.note: Only the tab (XRAI-FIVE_TAB_UX) and the goal DAG (XRAI-GOAL_DAG) have req ids; the daily self-report/rest loop has none. Self-report only, no mood inference.

records.title: Notification/attention budget, quiet hours and 'why shown' disclosure
found_in: constitution v2.1 §31.2 LF-04 (consent + quiet hours + attention budget)
records.note: No v3.1 req covers notification governance; XRAI-USER_AGENCY mentions no addiction loops only.

records.title: Personal year/month/day cycles and opt-in sourced daily symbolic theme
records.note: A registered method with no requirement row; must stay separated from self-reported energy (v0.4 handoff §3).

records.title: Voluntary cultural context with special-category consent; no protected-trait inference from name/face/location

records.title: Purpose hypothesis and experiment lab: 2-4 user-approved hypotheses labelled EXPLORATION_ONLY, small voluntary experiments
records.note: XRAI-SPIRITUAL_BOUNDARIES forbids certainty; no row specifies the hypothesis/experiment contract itself.

records.title: Personal decision intelligence (DecisionFrame): reversible/irreversible, alternatives, limits, 'none' option, no external action
records.note: No v3.1 req row.

records.title: Socratic reflective questioning and epistemic calibration (observation vs interpretation, counterexamples)
records.note: XRAI-OIE and XRAI-MENTOR_LENSES do not name the Socratic mode.

records.title: Relationships and boundaries practice (D4): user-authored only, no third-party profiling, no reconciliation pressure
records.note: XRAI-SEVEN_DIMENSIONS names the dimensions only; the D4 service and its third-party privacy rule have no row.

records.title: Contribution and generativity service (D6): voluntary, no altruism score, beneficiary data only with consent

records.title: Awe, wonder and transcendence experiences (D7): optional contemplative/art/nature/science, never an enlightenment badge

records.title: Life chapters, yearly review and legacy/portability (editable narrative, no fabricated then-vs-now)
